name: Levi's x Nike Air Max 95 OG 'Black Anthracite'
story_html: Drawn from a collaborative three-piece pack, the Levi's x Nike Air Max 95 OG 'Black Anthracite' showcases a black denim upper with frayed edges for a pre-distressed aesthetic. Heritage details remain intact, including mesh paneling that partially obscures the lacing system, as well as an embroidered Air Max logo atop the tongue. Additional branding elements include a mini-Swoosh on the lateral heel, accompanied by the iconic red Levi's tab.
